title: Gusto - All-in-one payroll, benefits, and HR for small businesses
clean_text: Gusto is an all-in-one HR platform for small businesses handling full-service payroll (automated tax filings, W-2s, 1099s, flexible pay schedules, contractor payments), HR and talent tools (recruiting, offer letters, onboarding, e-signatures), and benefits administration (health insurance, retirement plans) with automatic federal/state/local tax filing. It serves more than 300,000 small businesses, scaling from small to mid-sized companies without requiring a platform change as they grow, and is known for the range and simplicity of its integrations with accounting, applicant tracking, benefits, and time-tracking tools.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, base fee plus per-person
